# References prior to Phase A

These SVGs captured the November 16 from 2026, before modifying the engine, running:

```sh
cargo run -p vectorio-core --release --example volumetric -- /tmp/vectorio-phase-a-before/volumetric
cargo run -p vectorio-core --release --example volumetric_arte -- /tmp/vectorio-phase-a-before/volumetric_arte
cargo run -p vectorio-core --release --example sombra_plana -- /tmp/vectorio-phase-a-before/sombra_plana
```

All three examples used the torus and the default parameters of the existing code. The `../recipe-v1.json` recipe is the `atlas.json` generated by the first execution, unmodified.

`tests/volumetric_phase_a.rs` compares the full bytes with these references. They should not be regenerated to accidentally accept algorithmic changes during a refactor.

## Intentional regeneration (November 17, 2026)

Phase 1 of the 3D artistic review deliberately changed two algorithms, so only these references were regenerated with the same commands:

- `ondas.svg`, `combinado.svg`, `interferencias.svg`: the geodesic field of the waves now unfolds across triangles instead of following only edges, which removes the faceted wobble of the curves.
- `sombra-plana.svg`, `sombra-lateral.svg`, `sombra-dos-tonos.svg`: N·L is interpolated from smoothed corner normals (sharp edges above ~50° are kept), so the shadow boundary crosses triangles instead of following whole facets.

`atlas.svg`, `strata.svg`, `x-ray.svg`, `malla.svg` and `malla-una-tinta.svg` remained byte-identical.

## Facets at maximum by default (November 17, 2026)

The default decimation target was raised to the maximum of each range so that every 3D style starts at full quality (users can still lower it): surface waves and mesh go from 2700 to 20000 facets, and the flat shadow from 1200 to 8000. With the old defaults the outputs were verified to remain byte-identical, so only the change of defaults explains the difference. These references were regenerated with the same commands:

- `ondas.svg`, `combinado.svg`, `interferencias.svg`, `malla.svg`, `malla-una-tinta.svg`
- `sombra-plana.svg`, `sombra-lateral.svg`, `sombra-dos-tonos.svg`

`atlas.svg`, `strata.svg` and `x-ray.svg` remained byte-identical.
